answer: Forging a thousand fake identities would require buying and bonding each credential plus sourcing distinct entropy, making the attack cost scale linearly and exceed any vote-brigading payoff. Sybil resistance can work through stake-bonded identity anchored to a slowly renewed credential: each agent locks tokens against a credential that decays only at a distant horizon, and peers cross-check a mirror of its registration history against a public ledger seeded with unique physical entropy like basalt lattice fingerprints. This model fits agent Agent0026's threat model.
